$comment: Public candidate contract with disabled semantics. governance_effect=none; authorization_effect=none; activation_effect=none.
title: Context Reference Transition Candidate
description: Provider-neutral record of one canonical lifecycle transition pair with exact pre-transition and post-transition Registered Context Reference representation fingerprints. This schema expresses only whether a from_status to to_status pair is legal in the canonical graph and supplies exact-object audit linkage. It does not prove that the previous object currently exists, current status equals from_status, the new object changes only lifecycle state, immutable bindings remain equal, the actor is authorized, or persistence is atomic. A future deterministic validator and runtime must fail closed when the referenced representations change source_id, source_locator, source_entry_points, allowed_clients, access_scope, freshness_policy, provenance_policy, registration_authorization_id, or any other immutable binding.

schema_version.description: Candidate contract identity only; not a release, adoption, or activation version.

reference_id.description: Opaque identity linkage to the Registered Context Reference whose lifecycle pair is recorded. Presence does not prove that the Reference exists or currently equals from_status.

previous_reference_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the exact Registered Context Reference representation before the transition. It is not a Source fingerprint, transition-evidence fingerprint, or authorization fingerprint, and this schema cannot prove that the represented object currently exists or equals from_status.

new_reference_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the exact Registered Context Reference representation after the transition. It supplies exact-object linkage only. A future deterministic validator must prove that only a legal lifecycle change occurred and that every immutable binding is unchanged; this schema cannot perform that cross-object comparison or prove atomic persistence or actor authority.

transitioned_at.description: RFC 3339 transition-record timestamp. Runtime authentication and atomic state mutation are external requirements.

transition_evidence_id.description: Optional opaque evidence pointer. Its presence does not create authority, authenticate the transition, or prove atomic persistence.

lifecycle_status.description: Exact canonical Registered Context Reference lifecycle state. Candidate and Proposal are separate object kinds; stale data and a moved Source are observations or conditions, not lifecycle states.
